a.name: Screening room
a.description: A deep-steel band: the question centred, one wide click-to-play screen, and a programme line with a print of Jones, the sire.
a.differs_from: A facade with a section photo of the sire under the screen on a deep band; S2 is an iframe with no photo, S3 a plain facade with none.

b.name: Portrait reel
b.description: Ruled section: copy with an inline print of a puppy and its owner, beside a tall 4:5 poster of Cheryl with a brass play disc.
b.differs_from: A portrait facade beside copy that carries its own inline photo, framed by rules; the built rows are iframes in a card or on a band, or a plain facade with no photo.

c.name: Side panel
c.description: Sunk steel-100 tray: a wide poster of Christa with a Play the film pill beside a panel with Ince's photo and three ruled facts.
c.differs_from: A facade with a photo panel on its right inside a sunk tray (no shadow); S1 is a raised card round an iframe, S3 a plain facade with no photo.
